workflow_goal: Finalize the refaced dominion and Greek hero card set, keep runtime data in sync, and export per-card art prompts from the JSON descriptions.

icon_jobs.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: dominion suit icon for a fantasy card game. Primary request: create a clean vector-friendly leaf crown sigil for Verdant Court. Scene/backdrop: no scene, centered emblem on a plain light background. Subject: elegant leaf crown or interlocking branch crest. Style/medium: flat heraldic emblem, crisp linework, minimal shading. Composition/framing: centered, square, strong silhouette at small sizes. Lighting/mood: calm, ancient, elevated. Color palette: sage green, pale stone, dark ink accents. Constraints: no text, no border frame, no gradients that blur the shape, must read at card-corner size. Avoid: photorealism, clutter, extra weapons, other dominion motifs.

recommended_batch_order: Generate or refine the four dominion icons.
Generate one sample card for each dominion at rank 10 to validate framing and style.
Generate the remaining cards dominion by dominion.
Do a final pass for corner-rank readability consistency.
realm_card_generation.base_prompt_template: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: portrait fantasy playing card front. Primary request: create the front art for {name}. Scene/backdrop: {frame_notes}. Subject: {rank_title} of {dominion_name}; {art_brief}. Style/medium: mythic illustrated playing card, painterly but readable, single central silhouette. Composition/framing: portrait card composition with empty space protected in the top-left for the enlarged rank and icon overlay, plus a clean lower margin for the card name and dominion label. Lighting/mood: {card_feel}. Color palette: emphasize {color_name}. Constraints: include only one central figure or creature, preserve high contrast silhouette, avoid text baked into the art, avoid crowd scenes, avoid clipping the head or main weapon. Avoid: muddy rendering, mixed dominion motifs, tiny background details that overpower the character.
realm_card_generation.negative_prompt_hint: No watermark, no logo text, no extra characters, no modern props, no photoreal card mockup frame.

hero_card_generation.note: Greek hero identities are locked in greek_hero_asset_specs.json; use those names, emblems, and art briefs for final portraits.
hero_card_generation.base_prompt_template: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: portrait hero card front. Primary request: create the portrait art for {selected_figure}. Scene/backdrop: mythic Greek setting with restrained environment detail. Subject: {selected_figure}, chosen for the mechanic '{mechanic_summary}'. Style/medium: heroic mythic illustration, readable playing card portrait, strong silhouette. Composition/framing: centered portrait with preserved text box space in the lower third, preserved icon space in the top-left corner, and a clean title strip near the bottom. Lighting/mood: legendary, dramatic, clear at small scale. Constraints: no faction badge, no modern props, no text baked into the art, one clear subject only. Avoid: muddy backgrounds, crowd scenes, overly realistic photo style.
